$Comment: The first rung of the restless graveyard's ladder: reach the tenth wave in one run of the restless graveyard
Requires reads the run's best wave: ziggfreedcommon:counter with the Param Dungeon_Best_Wave on the
dungeon's own line (dungeon:@ and its id), ziggfreed-common's stat for the most waves a player cleared in
one run, the number on Records' Endless Runs tab. Min is the wave, and the description's number comes
from TextArgs, so keep the two equal. The criterion is a run of the graveyard that ends for the player
(INSTANCE_ROUND_ENDED on the dungeon's round, qualified by its id), counted only while Requires passes.
The library counts a run's end for the players still in the graveyard before it counts their best wave,
so a player there when their best run ends earns it as their next run ends; one who walked out between
waves has their best wave counted as they leave, and earns it as that run ends.
Factors/SeasonsOfOrbis/Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Best_Wave.json names the best wave in the lock line a
Earned once and kept: the graveyard opens on every full moon, so this has no Occurrence. Listing files
it under Seasons in a subcategory of its own, Restless_Graveyard, beside the ladder the Almanac's banner
walks; Chains draws its three rungs as one ladder. Rewards.Claim waits on the achievements page until
the player collects it: favor with the Hallowed, and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, whose own Requires
(the hytale:mod_installed gate) leaves it out on a server without that mod.
